messages:
Ana: quick heads-up — we have the release window in ~48h. please add a short release blurb under the 'Unreleased' section of the changelog and flag an owner. also we need a version bump PR before cutoff :clock2:
Devon: thanks! what's the desired blurb shape? short sentence + ticket? any required tags?
Ana: aim for 1-2 sentences. include (component) + PR # + Jira/issue if available. example format below — paste into changelog.md under the Unreleased heading:
```
- [runtime] (PR #4382) - reduce kv-cache memcpy on long prompt paths; improves tail latency for seq>2048 (owner: @devon, ISSUE-1123)
```
include a component in brackets, a one-line summary, then parenthetical owner and issue id. keep present-tense and reader-friendly.
release-bot: Reminder: release cutoff in 48 hours. Please ensure changelog entries, tests, and version bump PRs are merged. See: https://redwood.infr/releases/cutoff-guide
Maria: for hotfix/backports — should we add the backport label and ping the owners in this thread?
Ana: yes. please add label "backport/prepare" on the PR and ping the backport owner. if you need a dedicated backport branch, name it `release/v2.6.x-backport` and include the original PR in the description.
Sam: quick Q — will the release process auto-bump package.json, or should we open a manual bump PR?
Ana: we still do manual bumps for this release. use `npm version minor --no-git-tag-version` locally and open a PR titled `chore(release): bump to v2.6.0` with the changelog entry linked. ops will run the final tag creation at merge time.
Devon: ack. i'll add my blurb + owner tag now. @maria can you take care of backport labels for the related PR?
Maria: sure — i'll sweep PRs with label `release-candidate` and apply `backport/prepare` where needed.
Ana: perfect. last ask — react with :eyes: on your changelog entry when it's ready so I can do a quick skim before merge. thanks everyone!
